lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Divya Xi is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Divya Xi is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Divya kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Divya's gone." Mia looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Divya." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Maya blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d41: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Boiling Water (Level 1). Rolling boil for 1 minute kills most pathogens. The simplest safe water.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Anatomy (Level 1). You know where the important bits are. Arteries, joints, organs. Useful for healing or hurting.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Calming Panic (Level 1). Ground them: 5 things you see, 4 you hear, 3 you touch. Breathe with them. Slow is fast.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Soft Step (Level 1). Move through woods like weather. Less noise, fewer surprises.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Divya Xi, 41 days. The mantle passes to Maya Singh.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Maya Singh, 32 — an ER nurse. Her hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Beard Moss, Berserker Rage, Green Thumb, Literally.
d41: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Gardener of the Living Garden." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Divya — and Divya is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Dmitri, Mia speak for Maya — "Divya trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Maya before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
